title: Optimal triangulations for piecewise linear approximations of non-convex variable products
summary: We show optimal triangulations for piecewise linear (PWL) approximations of indefinite quadratic functions over the plane. Optimal triangulations have minimum triangle density while allowing a PWL approximation that fulfills a prescribed error bound measured in the L-infinity norm. In 2000, Pottmann et al. proved optimal triangulations for PWL interpolations and conjectured that these are also optimal for general PWL approximations.
